title: Tiny, cute piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of piano -->
  <rect x='15' y='30' width='70' height='45' rx='6' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <!-- lighter top edge -->
  <rect x='15' y='30' width='70' height='8' rx='6' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- music stand -->
  <rect x='30' y='18' width='40' height='14' rx='3' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <rect x='33' y='21' width='34' height='8' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- white keys -->
  <rect x='20' y='55' width='60' height='15' rx='3' fill='#FFF8F0'/>
  <!-- individual white key lines -->
  <line x1='29' y1='55' x2='29' y2='70' stroke='#E0D0B8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='55' x2='38' y2='70' stroke='#E0D0B8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='55' x2='47' y2='70' stroke='#E0D0B8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='55' x2='56' y2='70' stroke='#E0D0B8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='55' x2='65' y2='70' stroke='#E0D0B8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='55' x2='74' y2='70' stroke='#E0D0B8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- black keys -->
  <rect x='25' y='55' width='7' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <rect x='34' y='55' width='7' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <rect x='51' y='55' width='7' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <rect x='60' y='55' width='7' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <rect x='69' y='55' width='7' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <!-- gold trim -->
  <rect x='15' y='70' width='70' height='5' rx='2' fill='#DAA520'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='22' y='75' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <rect x='73' y='75' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <!-- cute face on the body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FFE4E1'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FFE4E1'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#2E1500'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#2E1500'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 49 Q50 54 58 49' fill='none' stroke='#FFE4E1' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- little music notes -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='25' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#FFD700' transform='rotate(-15 84 25)'/>
  <rect x='88' y='12' width='2' height='13' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='20' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FFD700' transform='rotate(15 12 20)'/>
  <rect x='6' y='9' width='2' height='11' fill='#FFD700'/>
</svg>
